description: Append-only protection contract for Gate_SDK repository-root files. Read by validate_root_file_protection.py. A version rewrite of pyproject.toml requires ALLOW-ROOT-DELETION in a commit message and the protected-root PR template.

rules.additive_only: A PR may only add lines unless a matching ALLOW-ROOT-DELETION marker is in the PR commit messages.
rules.managed: Edits are allowed without a justification marker.
rules.regenerable: Machine-generated artifact. Exempt from the additive check.

justification.recorded_in: any commit message in the PR range (base..head)

pr_template.required_when: any additive_only protected_files path is in the PR diff
pr_template.enforced_by: validate_root_file_protection.py --require-pr-body; make pr fills the Protected-root block
